ui_bugs.issue: ComparisonCell component is defined (line 241) but NEVER rendered. The 'COMPARATIVA DE IMPACTO · BEFORE → AFTER' panel is missing from result-panel. critical_code_review_comments: Optimizer.jsx defines ComparisonCell helper (line 241-269) but the JSX block referencing it was forgotten in the result-panel render (line 180-209). Likely lost during refactor — the imports TrendUp/TrendDown are present, so wiring is partial.
scheduler.py SchedulerEngine: _engine is a module-level singleton — fine for single-process FastAPI, but be aware uvicorn workers >1 will have N independent engines. Document or add a Mongo lock.

scheduler.py inserts events with custom _id = rule_id + str(loop_time). Mixing custom string _id with normal find queries is OK but be careful to keep `_id` excluded from API responses. /api/scheduler/events already excludes _id ({_id: 0}) — verified.
metrics_compare.compute_delta uses round(...,2) and divides by zero only when before == 0 (handled: returns 0%) — solid.

Frontend Scheduler.jsx UX: 'INICIAR' button toggles to 'DETENER' correctly, status bar reflects ACTIVO state and toast shows. Polling loop NOT implemented (status only refreshes on user action) — minor; consider a 5s setInterval for live status.

rca of the issue: Bug: Missing JSX render block for ComparisonCell in Optimizer.jsx. Reproduction: navigate to /optimize → click EJECUTAR AHORA → wait for result-panel → search for text 'COMPARATIVA' or any [data-testid^='comp-cell-'] element → none found. Root cause: helper component ComparisonCell defined at end of file but never invoked in JSX (verified via `grep -n 'ComparisonCell' /app/frontend/src/pages/Optimizer.jsx` returns only the function definition line). Mitigation: insert a new <div> block inside result-panel that renders 4 ComparisonCell instances bound to result.comparison.cpu_percent / memory_percent / disk_percent / processes_count when result?.comparison exists, with appropriate units ('%','%','%','') and stable testids.
